answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the jade log shows the live set and the inlet audit records each lapse. Keeping 89 aliases alive thus means 89 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the nebula quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 464 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
